Network namespace setup and teardown for veth links, addresses, and ethtool settings.

# Purpose
This file defines the `netns` configure stage for a development setup that uses Linux network namespaces. It is not an executable entry point or a general library. It is a configuration helper that creates, checks, and removes two network namespaces and the virtual Ethernet link between them. The stage is enabled by `config->development.netns.enabled`, and it uses the `config_t` values for namespace names, MAC addresses, IP addresses, and the number of network tiles.

The [`init`](<#init>) function creates the namespaces, builds a `veth` pair, assigns addresses, brings the links up, and changes interface channel settings and offload settings with `ethtool` to match the needs of the QUIC network tiles. The [`fini`](<#fini>) function removes the link and namespaces. The [`check`](<#check>) function tests whether the namespace files exist under `/var/run/netns/` and reports whether the stage is configured, missing, or only partly configured. The file ends by exporting the `fd_cfg_stage_netns` descriptor, which connects these functions to the wider configure framework.
